Fronds

The characteristics of fronds were recorded in Table 2. Based on the ratio of frond length/width, the broadest frond was Barni Al-Eis (3.5) and the narrowest one was Loun (6.75). the range of frond length was from 545.33 cm (Barni Al-Madinah) to 297 cm (Majdool) while the range of frond width was from 106.17 cm (Barni Al-Madinah) to 55.67 cm (Mabroom Al-Ula). There was a difference among cultivars in the percentage of pinnated part and spined part in the total frond length (Fig. 3). The measure was replicated in six fronds in each palm.
